title: Agentic AI Conversational Platform
tagline: Voice and chat AI that deflected about 30% of card-support calls
domain: Enterprise AI platform (voice and chat), banking and fintech
summary: A 0-to-1 agentic platform with three-tier resolution that deflected about 30% of calls for a card issuer.
brief: Problem: a card issuer's contact center could not keep pace with 150K+ cardholders growing by 20K a month, with wait times rising about 20% month on month.
Call: chose a three-tier resolution model (RAG self-serve, agentic transactional flows, human escalation) on a hybrid NLU + LLM design, instead of a single LLM bot.
Role: Senior Product Manager; led the 0-to-1 build.
Result: about 30% call deflection, 93.5%+ command generation accuracy, and an evaluation framework adopted across the AI platform.
